description: This file contains test cases for functions related to spawn metadata normalization, workspace inheritance resolution, and ingress workspace override handling, primarily used in a testing context with the Vitest framework.

methods.name: normalizeSpawnedRunMetadata
methods.description: Normalizes the spawn metadata object by trimming whitespace and removing empty fields.

methods.name: mapToolContextToSpawnedRunMetadata
methods.description: Maps agent group context to spawn run metadata.

methods.name: resolveSpawnedWorkspaceInheritance
methods.description: Resolves the workspace directory for a spawned run based on configuration, explicit override, or requesting agent.

methods.name: resolveIngressWorkspaceOverrideForSpawnedRun
methods.description: Determines if the workspace override applies based on the spawnedBy identifier.
